transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I'm seeking help because I've been struggling with really intense, distressing memories and flashbacks of a traumatic event that happened about a year and a half ago. It often feels like I'm constantly reliving it, and I just can't get the images out of my head.
Have you been avoiding places, people, or situations that remind you of the traumatic event?

Yes, I actively do everything I can to avoid them. I completely stay away from the area where it happened and avoid any conversations or people that might bring it up. Encountering those reminders just triggers those awful memories and makes me panic.
Have you been feeling constantly on edge, easily startled, or having trouble sleeping or concentrating since the event?

Yes, I feel constantly tense and on edge, and I just can't seem to relax even when I'm in a safe place. I'm also having a really hard time concentrating on daily things, like trying to read or even just keeping up with a conversation.
